name: jev-engineering
description: Move an agent's non-generative decisions off the frontier model onto a cheap calibrated decision layer, and gate them on confidence. Model routing, input guardrails, tool-call gating, inbox triage, reranking, LLM evals, bulk labelling, real-time control, and the confidence gate itself.
$notes: Hooks are NOT declared here on purpose. The wiring lives in .claude/settings.json.example
and is enabled by hand once TYPESAFE_API_KEY is set -- without a key the gate correctly
falls back to 'ask', which means a permission prompt on every Bash call.
See CLAUDE.md, 'Hooks ship inert, on purpose'.
